body.statement: Using \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{eff}}\), characterize the efficient influence function and efficiency bound for \(\theta\) in the constrained model \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{face}}\) that exploits common untreated kernels, the latent Markov factorization, and date \(4\); determine whether a regular estimator attains that bound uniformly on \(\mathcal P_{\kappa}\), and characterize exactly when its variance is strictly below \(\Sigma(p)\).
body.justification: The saturated gradient deliberately leaves information in the common-kernel restrictions and fifth date unused, so the constrained efficiency problem is genuine rather than a routine restatement.
body.gap: Newey supplies the tangent-space projection principle and Bonhomme, Jochmans, and Robin derive regular spectral-estimator asymptotics, but no adjacent paper characterizes the tangent space or efficient ATT score for this absorbing latent Markov face.
body.consumer: A solution would tell practitioners whether the transparent four-slice estimator pays an avoidable precision cost and would provide the benchmark for efficient likelihood or minimum-distance implementations.
